name: liquid-metal
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Liquid Metal style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#09090B, #52525B, #D4D4D8, #FFFFFF). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
